questions.stem: In a workshop dedicated to vaccine storage and handling, the topic of the "shake test" is introduced. This test is a practical method used to determine if freeze-sensitive vaccines have been damaged due to freezing. The participants are presented with a list of vaccines and asked to identify for which vaccine the shake test is not applicable. This question aims to assess their understanding of the shake test and its relevance to different types of vaccines, especially in the context of freeze sensitivity.
